About Rajesh

Rajesh brings decades of real estate mastery in Pune, specializing in high-growth corridors like Wakad, Bibwewadi, and Lullanagar. Having personally overseen the delivery of landmark residential communities and commercial hubs, he is known for his unwavering commitment to structural integrity, transparent documentation, and timely project handovers.

Outside of property development, Rajesh actively supports local urban greening initiatives and mentors young professionals entering Pune's growing real estate sector.
